## Summary

What problem does this change solve for a fan?

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Accessibility / UI polish
- [ ] Provider data reliability
- [ ] Documentation / tests

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passed
- [ ] Relevant regressions were added or updated
- [ ] Browser interaction tested (if UI changed)
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or large raw datasets were included
- [ ] Live provider data remains distinct from simulated cricket demo data
- [ ] No unseen score, match status, or event is disclosed through copy, color, or metadata

## Evidence

Reproduction steps, test results, and screenshots if relevant.

## Notes

Known limitations, upstream-provider changes, or behavior changes reviewers should verify.
